# AuditReady AI

> AuditReady AI is a SOC 2 compliance automation platform for startups. Connect your tools (starting with GitHub), get an instant SOC 2 readiness score in under 10 minutes, close compliance gaps with AI-guided fixes, and walk into enterprise deals audit-ready — without hiring consultants or spending weeks on manual evidence collection.

AuditReady AI helps engineering-led teams *prepare* for a SOC 2 audit. It tracks evidence, identifies control gaps, and generates AI-assisted readiness reports and policy documents. It does not replace an official attestation by a licensed CPA firm — it gets you ready for one, faster and cheaper.

## Core Capabilities

- Instant SOC 2 readiness score: connect GitHub and get a scored assessment in under 10 minutes
- Full 49-control Trust Services Criteria (TSC) mapping with automated gap detection
- AI policy document generator for framework-aligned documentation
- Evidence Locker: centralized evidence collection with renewal and expiry due-date tracking
- Vendor Risk Tracker for third-party risk management
- Exportable Audit Readiness reports, ready to hand to your auditor
- Live public Trust Page with a shareable link to prove readiness to prospects
- On-demand rescans that keep your score current as your stack changes
- AI that stays aligned with framework changes automatically

## Who It's For

- Pre-seed and seed-stage startups closing their first enterprise deals
- Series A companies undergoing an active SOC 2 audit
- Engineering-led teams that want compliance readiness without dedicated GRC headcount

## Pricing

- Starter — $250/mo: GitHub integration, full 49-control TSC mapping, AI policy generator, exportable readiness report, score dashboard and gap tracker
- Growth — $500/mo: everything in Starter plus on-demand scans, live Trust Page with share link, AI audit report generation, Evidence Locker, Vendor Risk Tracker, renewal tracking
- Audit-Ready — $1,000/mo: everything in Growth plus priority founder-level support, early access to new integrations, custom control mapping, hands-on onboarding
